quirks: NZX Limited's own IR lives on nzxgroup.com, not nzx.com (old /about-nzx/investor-centre path 404s). FY ends 31 Dec; H1 = six months to 30 June, same calendar year (no FY offset). H1-2026 filing restated revenue to a gross basis (fund expenses no longer netted): +$5.894m for H1-2025 and +$12.303m for FY2025, profit lines unaffected — revenue not comparable back past FY2024. Balance sheet carries restricted clearing cash and third-party funds that are NOT own cash.
